name: Sample Export Styles
author: QuoteBrowser
description: Two sample HTML export styles bundled with QuoteBrowser 1.87+ to show how export-style packs work. Pick one in Export → HTML → Export style.

settings.title: Serif headings
settings.description: Render the page title and quote headers in a serif font. (Sample setting — it demonstrates a stored toggle; the pack's own CSS doesn't read it.)

settings.title: Footer text
settings.description: Custom line shown at the bottom of the settings page preview. (Sample setting.)

settings.title: Accent color
settings.description: Preferred accent for future styles in this pack. (Sample setting.)
